test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

_ n p _ r r _ p _ m m _ p q _ r q _ n m _ n p _ r r q _ n m
solution:
The logic followed here is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a1ac20089d6ce27a975baa62e39d1d448f345f31dffec147f5ccb86eb478e88.png] 

Here, we can see that it follows a repeating pattern of 'mnpqrrqpnm'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****mqqnnrpmqp"**.
